name: simpledbv2
description: Amazon SimpleDB is a web service providing the core database functions of data indexing and querying in the cloud.

subcommands.name: get-export
subcommands.description: Returns information for an existing domain export.

subcommands.name: list-exports
subcommands.description: Lists all exports that were created.

subcommands.name: start-domain-export
subcommands.description: Initiates the export of a SimpleDB domain to an S3 bucket.

subcommands.name: wait
subcommands.description: Wait until a particular condition is satisfied.

subcommands.name: export-succeeded
subcommands.description: Wait until JMESPath query exportStatus returns SUCCEEDED when polling with ``get-export``.
